requisito: Processes a list of (azione, sku, qta) commands against initial giacenze without mutating the input dictionary, skipping None entries, empty/None sku, or qta <= 0, and raising ValueError for actions other than PRENOTA and RILASCIA. PRENOTA deducts stock when available (>= qta) and tracks reserved units; RILASCIA succeeds only when reserved >= qta. Returns "non valido" if giacenze or ordini is None or soglia < 0; otherwise returns fulfilled count, rejected count, total still-reserved units, and SKUs with stock <= soglia.

difetti.indizio: Look at the loop that removes zeroed entries from the prenotati dictionary.
difetti.spiegazione: Iterating directly over prenotati while running del prenotati[k] mutates the dictionary during iteration and raises RuntimeError as soon as a SKU is fully released.

difetti.indizio: Check the condition deciding whether available stock is enough to fulfill a reservation.
difetti.spiegazione: Using scorte[cod] > qta instead of >= rejects reservations that exactly exhaust the remaining stock of a SKU.

difetti.indizio: Look at which dictionary is iterated to count low-stock alert SKUs at the end.
difetti.spiegazione: The loop iterates over prenotati.values() instead of scorte.values(), checking the threshold against reserved quantities rather than remaining warehouse stock.

difetti.indizio: Check the guard on command fields before normalizing the SKU string.
difetti.spiegazione: Calling sku.strip() without checking for sku being None first raises AttributeError as soon as a command has a null SKU.

difetti.indizio: Look at the inequality that decides when a reservation is allowed.
difetti.spiegazione: The condition scorte[cod] < qta is inverted relative to >=: it rejects orders covered by stock and accepts those exceeding stock, driving inventory negative.

difetti.indizio: Look at how the SKU code read from each command is normalized.
difetti.spiegazione: Missing .upper() on sku.strip() prevents lowercase or mixed-case SKU codes from matching the normalized keys in scorte, causing valid orders to be rejected.
